Very slightly soluble in water; slightly solu- ble in acetone and in alcohol; dissolves in solutions of alkali hy- droxides and carbonates. Protect from light. Profile Succinylsulfathiazole is a sulfonamide with properties similar to those of sulfamethoxazole (p.340). It is poorly absorbed and has been given for its antibacterial activity in the gastrointestinal tract.
